The Winner pinball machine, manufactured by Sega Enterprises, Ltd. in 1971, is an electro-mechanical, single-player game with a horse-racing theme.

- Manufacturer: Sega Enterprises, Ltd.
- Years made: 1971
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Sports, Horses, Original Theme, Horse Racing, 1970s
